name: job-search-assistant
description: Modular job-search assistant: setup + personas, self-discovery, LinkedIn review, resume & cover letter tailoring, networking & event prep, interview prep/practice/debrief, negotiation, and daily stand-up / weekly retro. Bring your own tools or none.

interface.shortDescription: Eight skills for the whole job search, from targeting to the offer
interface.longDescription: Setup with a coach persona, self-discovery, LinkedIn scoring and rewrites, resume tailoring, networking drafts, interview prep and mock interviews, negotiation, and a daily/weekly rhythm. Grounded in The 2-Hour Job Search, Never Search Alone, Reverse the Search, Linked and The Job Closer. Drafts only; never sends.
